name: Sentiment of Text
description:
Paste any text and see at a glance whether it reads positive, negative, or neutral — with the analysis done privately on your device.

**How it works:** You paste text, a local AI model gauges the mood, and the result is shown to you.

**Setup:**
- Install and enable the awflow browser extension.
- Pick an on-device AI model the first time you run it.

**Good for:** checking the tone of reviews, feedback, or messages before you act on them.
setup: Install / enable the awflow browser extension.
